newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Newcrest says no revision of Cadia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Newcrest says no revision of Cadia.

text.p: Gold miner Newcrest Mining Ltd said on Monday it would not revise the dimensions or construction budget of its Cadia Mine in central western New South Wales following state government approval of the project.
"A go-ahead decision is not going to alter what we're going to do," Newcrest spokesman David Sasson told Reuters.
The A$440 million project is expected to produce an average of 293,000 ounces of gold and 23,000 tonnes of copper a year.
New South Wales (NSW) premier Bob Carr earlier said state government approval of the mine would be announced later Monday.
Construction of Cadia was expected to commence October 1, Sassion said.
"It's a two-year construction period. Commissioning of the mills should be completed by towards the end of the third quarter of 1998," he added.
In pre-open trade, Newcrest shares were bid at A$4.60, unchanged from Friday.
